title: OriginsCraft
description: A datapack to improve your game life in vanilla!
body:
This pack include some fix to make minecraft **better**!
Include:
- ·Add recipes about craft non-renewable things,furnace can smelt raw block and stonecutter can cut wood.
- ·Change some mobs drop like piglin now will drop arrow.
- ·Break grass drop more kind of seeds and seagrass drop coral.
- ·Piglin trade,fishing,cat gift,sniffer dig this event loots become better.
- ·Structures chest have more loots.

Enjoy!

_Tell me some idea to make this pack more better!_
